answer: Proof of Stake achieves Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital, turning a violet asset-based barrier into a verifiable vote. Much like a falcon tracking prey, the consensus protocol monitors validator behavior to punish malicious actors via slashing. While an attacker might attempt to craft a sonnet of fake identities, the linear cost of acquiring enough stake makes such a horizontal expansion economically irrational, as it scales linearly with the total value secured by the network.
